ID_PLAY_SCR_CAMPAIGN_DESCRIPTION: Fight for the Empire as Commander Iden Versio, leader of the Empire's extraordinary special operations team: Inferno Squad.
ID_PLAY_SCR_CAMPAIGN_MISSIONSELECT_DESC: Replay any completed chapter with a new loadout, different abilities, or to locate hidden collectibles.
ID_PLAY_SCR_DLC_DESC: Iden Versio's story continues as the First Order rises to power. The galaxy needs  Inferno Squad's Commander once more.
ID_PLAY_SCR_DLC_DESC_LOCKED: Please complete the main story before starting Resurrection
ID_PLAY_SCR_DLC_MISSIONSELECT_DESC: Replay any completed chapter with a new loadout or different abilities.
ID_PLAY_SCR_MAINSTORY_DESC: Fight for the Empire as Commander Iden Versio, leader of the Empire's extraordinary special operations team Inferno Squad.
ID_PLAY_SCR_MODE1_DESC: Armies collide to dominate the battlefront in an open-ended tug-of-war. Utilize a wide array of tactics, trooper classes, land vehicles, reinforcement units, and hero characters to attack and defend strategic assets in this era-authentic mode.
ID_PLAY_SCR_MODE9_DARK_DESC: Show no mercy and prove your allegiance to the Separatist Alliance.
ID_PLAY_SCR_MODE9_DESC: Join a squad of four players and go up against the enemy team of AI opponents. As an attacker, capture one of the Command Posts to continue the battle into the next phase. As a defender, prevent the enemies from capturing any of your Command Posts to stop their advance.
ID_PLAY_SCR_MODE9_LIGHT_DESC: Resist the powers of evil and join the fight in the name of the Galactic Republic.
ID_PLAY_SCR_MULTIPLAYER_DESCRIPTION: A selection of multiplayer modes, from large to small, that let you to take control of your favorite characters, pilot extraordinary vehicles, and visit beautiful worlds.
ID_PLAY_SCR_MULTIPLAYER_GROUP_ALREADY_PL: LEAVE GROUP TO START A NEW MATCH
ID_PLAY_SCR_MULTIPLAYER_GROUP_TOO_LARGE: YOUR GROUP HAS TOO MANY PLAYERS
ID_PLAY_SCR_MULTIPLAYER_NEED_ONLINE: YOU NEED TO BE ONLINE TO PLAY
ID_PLAY_SCR_RESTARTCAMPAIGN_CONFIRMATION: This will reset all of your story and campaign character progression.
ID_PLAY_SCR_RESTARTCAMPAIGN_DESC: Restart the story and experience Inferno Squad’s journey from the beginning. This will erase existing save data.
ID_PLAY_SCR_RESTARTDLC_CONFIRMATION: This will reset all progression for Resurrection
ID_PLAY_SCR_RESTARTDLC_DESC: Restart Iden and Zay's story from the beginning. This will erase existing Resurrection save data.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SINGLEPLAYER_DESC: Fight through the Campaign of Iden Versio, jump into larger-than-life Star Wars battles against AI foes in Instant Action, or take on a variety of scenarios in Arcade.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_COOP_DESC: Team up with a friend in a split-screen co-op Arcade.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_CUSTOM_CONFIRMATION: Are you sure you want to play Arcade with these settings?
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_CUSTOM_DESC_CONSOLE: Ready for a round of shooting practice? Lightsaber training? How about an epic showdown against legions of elite stormtroopers? Modify the game rules, alter the AI and change gameplay settings to play how you want.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_CUSTOM_DESC_PC: Ready for a round of shooting practice? Lightsaber training? How about an epic showdown against legions of elite stormtroopers? Modify the game rules, alter the AI and change gameplay settings to play how you want.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_DARK_SIDE_DESC: Show no mercy and prove your allegiance to the Separatists, the Galactic Empire, or the First Order.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_DESCRIPTION: Become a master of combat with Arcade. Fight against AI-controlled enemies and earn rewards as you learn to master all of your troopers, heroes, weapons and abilities.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_LIGHT_SIDE_DESC: Resist the powers of evil and join the fight in the name of the Republic, the Rebel Alliance, or the Resistance.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_ORIGINAL_DARK_SIDE_: Show no mercy and prove your allegiance to the Galactic Empire.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_ORIGINAL_LIGHT_SIDE: Resist the powers of evil and join the fight in the name of the Rebel Alliance.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_SCENARIO_DESC_CONSO: Scenarios are specially orchestrated encounters from all eras of STAR WARS. Complete them all to become a formidable combatant and earn unique rewards. Bring a friend to team up in split-screen Co-op.
Scenarios are specially orchestrated encounters from all eras of STAR WARS. Complete them all to become a formidable combatant and earn unique rewards.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_SCENARIO_DESC_PC: Scenarios are specially orchestrated encounters from all eras of STAR WARS.  Complete them all to become a formidable combatant and earn unique rewards.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_SEQUEL_DARK_SIDE_DE: Show no mercy and prove your allegiance to the First Order.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_SEQUEL_LIGHT_SIDE_D: Resist the powers of evil and join the fight in the name of the Resistance.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_SINGLE_DESC: Take on Arcade by yourself and face off against the AI.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_TUTORIAL_DESC: Learn the basics of trooper and hero combat in Battlefront II. Destroy the Resistance forces daring enough to attack Starkiller Base as a First Order trooper or as Kylo Ren himself.
ID_PLAY_SCR_SKIRMISH_VERSUS_DESC: Go head-to-head in a split-screen versus Arcade.
